statements.title: the zero-count criterion: χ_λ(g_{p/q}) ≠ 0 iff N_q(λ+ρ) = N_q(ρ), at every rational point of the ρ-line
statements.formal_part: In the paper (Formalization, Lean 4 + Mathlib, commit 6283de8): in type C_m, for the products F_x(X) = ∏_{α>0}(1 − X^{(x,α)}), Lean proves that F_ρ divides F_ℓ (dvd_rho_ring over any commutative ring, dvd_rho over fields of characteristic zero), so the quotient Q with F_ρ·Q = F_ℓ is a polynomial and no divisibility is assumed; and the criterion for Q(ζ) at every q, for the positive pairings of type C_m (thm_crit, thm_crit′), with N_q(ρ) ≤ N_q(ℓ) (Nq_rho_le, N_rho_le). Not formalized: the identification χ_λ(g_{p/q}) = ζ^{−(λ,ρ)}Q(ζ) from Weyl’s formula (§3; checked exactly on 85 weights, certificate C1); the step from a dominant λ to ℓ = λ+ρ (Lean takes ℓ as a list of m integers with positive pairings); and the theorem outside type C_m, where it is printed but not formalized.

statements.title: the alphabet of a_P^k is d·μ_q less two letters: two copies of 1 (d even), or 1 and −1 (d odd)
every character is an integer at g_{1/q} exactly for q | 2m, q | 2m+1, q | 2m+2, or q = 6 with m ≡ 1 (mod 3)
statements.formal_part: In the paper (Formalization, Lean 4 + Mathlib, commit 6283de8): for q ≥ 2 and a primitive q-th root ζ, all elementary symmetric functions of the multiset {ζ^{±j} : 1 ≤ j ≤ m} are integers iff one of the four conditions of the theorem holds (Segmentos.thm_clasif_spectral, in IntegralPoints, with stable_iff_cond and esymm_int_iff_stable); lem_seg and seg_stable_of_dvd classify the stable segments for n ≥ 3 by Amiot’s lemma, another route than the Dirichlet kernels of the proof. Not formalized: the equivalence of §5 with the integrality of all characters of Sp(2m) (checked exactly on 455 characters, 44 pairs, certificate C2).

statements.title: type C: χ_λ(a_P^k) ≠ 0 iff no folded class modulo q holds more than d of the ℓ_i (⌊d/2⌋ on a fixed class)
statements.formal_part: In the paper (Formalization, Lean 4 + Mathlib, commit 6283de8): the capacity criterion on the side of the counts, over ZMod q: N_q(x) ≥ N_q(ρ), with equality iff no capacity is exceeded (ResidueCapacity). The link to the character is Theorem 3.1, with the scope stated there.

statements.title: the one unit of slack: m = dq/2 − 1 rows against a total capacity dq/2 (d even) or dq/2 − 1 (d odd)
statements.formal_part: In the paper (Formalization, Lean 4 + Mathlib, commit 6283de8): the total deficit of two letters behind the proposition (ResidueCapacity.sum_deficit: the deficits d − o_x(g) add up to 2); and, in the unfolded form over ZMod q, under the capacities exactly one folded class falls one short (d even) or the occupancies are saturated (d odd) (shape_even, shape_odd).

statements.title: the value at every power, sign included: χ_λ(a_P^k) = (−1)^{E_{p,q}(λ)} Z_q(λ+ρ)/Z_q(ρ) on the survivors, 0 elsewhere
statements.formal_part: In the paper (Formalization, Lean 4 + Mathlib, commit 6283de8): on the surviving weights, ζ^{−(λ,ρ)}Q(ζ) = (−1)^{E_{p,q}(λ)} Z_q(ℓ)/Z_q(ρ) at ζ = e^{2πip/q} with gcd(p,q) = 1 and dq = 2m+2 (thm_signo, thm_signo′, in RhoLineSign and RhoLineDvd); with thm_crit for the vanishing case, the whole statement for Q, sign included. Not formalized: the identification of ζ^{−(λ,ρ)}Q(ζ) with χ_λ (Weyl’s formula) and the step from a dominant λ to ℓ, as in Theorem 3.1.

statements.title: at k = 2, the absolute value is a product of one factor per folded class
statements.formal_part: In the paper (Formalization, Lean 4 + Mathlib, commit 6283de8): at k = 2, |Q(ζ)| is the product over the pairings divisible by q of (ℓ,α)/q (thm_val_k2, thm_val_k2_norm; every divisible pairing of ρ equals q, rho_div_pairs_eq_q). Not formalized: the regrouping into one factor D_c per folded class, which is how the theorem is stated; and, as in Theorem 3.1, the identification with χ_λ and the step from λ to ℓ.

statements.title: the non-vanishing part of the C_{q−1} Weyl product over μ_q less one point does not depend on the point
statements.formal_part: In the paper (Formalization, Lean 4 + Mathlib, commit 6283de8): the version with ordered pairs, M_s² = V_s·C_s·D_s with the punctured Vandermonde q^{q−2} and C_s·D_s = q^{q−2}·D, which the note identifies with M_s² = M_0². Not formalized: the step from the unordered product M_s = A_sB_sD_s to that expression.

statements.title: the absolute value at any power is the ratio of the vanishing root values, |χ| = Z_q(ℓ)/Z_q(ρ)
statements.formal_part: In the paper (Formalization, Lean 4 + Mathlib, commit 6283de8): at the powers of a_P (dq = 2m + 2), |Q(ζ)| = ∏_{q∣(ℓ,α)}(ℓ,α) / ∏_{q∣(ρ,α)}(ρ,α) for any ℓ with positive pairings and N_q(ℓ) = N_q(ρ) (thm_valgen; thm_valgen′ with F_ρ·Q = F_ℓ now proved). Not formalized: the identification with χ_λ and the step from λ to ℓ, as in Theorem 3.1.

statements.title: the surviving factors of the limit have modulus one
statements.formal_part: In the paper (Formalization, Lean 4 + Mathlib, commit 6283de8): with ζ primitive, dq = 2m+2 and equal counts, the non-vanishing factors of ℓ and of ρ have equal modulus, without any divisibility of the products (lem_unit, through the residue lemma ResidueCapacity.prop_res_cap). Not formalized: the step from a dominant λ to ℓ = λ+ρ (ℓ is a list of m integers with positive pairings).

statements.title: the residue lemma: ℛ_x = (P_x(X)² + P_x(X²))/2 − m in ℤ[X]/(X^q − 1), and ℛ_{λ+ρ} = ℛ_ρ under the capacities
statements.formal_part: In the paper (Formalization, Lean 4 + Mathlib, commit 6283de8): the residue identities: the identity in the form 2ℛ_x + 2m = P_x² + P_x(X²) over a finite abelian group (eq_res), and ℛ_x = ℛ_ρ under the capacities over ZMod q (prop_res_cap).

statements.title: the difference of the two residue histograms is the histogram of another root system, C_r or D_r
the modulus factors as κ ∈ {1, 2} times dimensions of GL_n, Sp_2n and SO_2n+1 representations, one per folded class
statements.formal_part: In the paper (Formalization, Lean 4 + Mathlib, commit 6283de8): both parities: the factorisation of Z_q(ℓ)/Z_q(ρ) into κ·|D_0|·|D_{q/2}|·∏_c|D_c|, with κ = 1 when d is odd or the free place lies in the class 0 and κ = 2 otherwise (dims_odd, dims_odd_occ, dims_even_occ; GL on the non-fixed classes, Sp on the class 0, SO on the class q/2); the occupancies of the folded classes are derived from N_q(ℓ) = N_q(ρ) (occ_odd, occ_even). Not formalized: the partitions ν^{(c)} and the oriented rows enter as data with their defining equations (that ν^{(c)} is a partition is not proved), for lists ℓ of length m (the step from a dominant λ to ℓ is not stated).

statements.title: a closed count of the surviving residues modulo q, for every q, in type C
in G_2 the vanishing at q = 3 and q = 2 is a congruence on (a, b)
statements.formal_part: In the paper (Formalization, Lean 4 + Mathlib, commit 6283de8): the two congruences on the counts (G2Counts: N_q against r_q at q = 3 and q = 2). The link to the vanishing of the character is the criterion of Theorem 3.1; the signed value of G_2 in the box after the corollary is not formalized.

statements.title: read through coroots, R_P(q) contains the R(q) of the dual group, with equality when gcd(q, r) = 1
statements.formal_part: In the paper (Formalization, Lean 4 + Mathlib, commit 6283de8): the arithmetic statement over any crystallographic root pairing with a base (PHeight): the coroot coefficients in the dual base, ht_P(α) = ((α,α)/2)·ht(α^∨) = (ρ,α), and the three clauses, under the stated hypothesis on the two root lengths ((α,α)/2 ∈ {1, r}) and a ρ with ⟨ρ, α_i^∨⟩ = 1.
